File guide — a perfect import, every time

Pick the format you have. Each one shows exactly how to get it out of EPLAN and what it must contain.

CSV / TXTEPLAN’s standard text export›

Get it from EPLAN: Utilities → Reports → Copper / busbar parts list → output as file → CSV (semicolon).

  • Semicolon ; comma , or tab — detected automatically
  • UTF-8 and UTF-16 encodings both open correctly
  • German 1.250,5 and English 1250.5 decimals both work
  • A missing header row is fine — you map the columns manually
Menge;Bezeichnung;Breite;Höhe;Länge
4;Sammelschiene L1;40;10;1.250,5
2;Abgang Q1;30;5;445,25
XLSXExcel workbook›

Get it from EPLAN: export the parts list as Excel, or open any export in Excel and save as .xlsx.

  • The first worksheet is read; the first row becomes the headers
  • Formulas are fine — their calculated values are used
  • Legacy .xls (pre-2007) is not supported — re-save as .xlsx or CSV
PasteCopy rows straight from Excel / EPLAN›

Select the table in Excel or the EPLAN preview, copy, switch to Paste from Excel/EPLAN above and paste. Include the header row if you have one — mapping gets guessed for you.

* required · Width + Thickness can be replaced by the combined column · anything unreadable is flagged with its exact line number and a fix — nothing is dropped silently.

How to export from EPLAN

EPLAN Pro Panel: Utilities → Reports → Copper parts list → output as file → choose CSV (semicolon). EPLAN Electric P8: export the busbar BOM via Utilities → Reports → Generate → Parts list, then save/export the table as CSV. Columns like Menge / Breite / Höhe / Länge are detected automatically.
